author: Haudricourt, André-Georges; Ozanne-Rivierre, Françoise
title: Dictionnaire thématique des langues de la région de Hienghène (Nouvelle-Calédonie): pije, fwâi, nemi, jawe
notes: Consulted directly on 23 November 2026 (excerpt, pp. 1-61 of the Peeters reprint; tables read from page images, the OCR layer being unusable). The comparative introduction 'Langues de Hienghène et proto-océanien: phonologie comparée' (pp. 9-59) is by Ozanne-Rivierre: the four languages and their dialects (§1, pp. 9-16), their phoneme systems (§2, pp. 17-23), POc correspondences (§3.3, pp. 33-53) and the summary Table 3.3.4 (pp. 54-55). Data from fieldwork by Haudricourt in 1959 and by Ozanne-Rivierre in 1973, 1976 and 1978. POc is written in Grace's (1969) orthography with *d for the retroflex (Ross's *r), *nt, *nd, *mp, *ŋp, *ŋm, *ŋk (Ross's *d, *dr, *b, *bʷ, *mʷ, *ɡ), and *s and *ns interchanged with respect to Grace's lists (n. 57).
